verbose.description: Enable verbose output to show detailed detection steps and format variants

recursive.description: Enable recursive analysis (e.g., decompress gzip/bzip2 and re-analyze contents)

paths.description: List of file paths or device nodes to analyze; may include disk images and raw block devices

suppress.description: List of format names (as recognized by disktype) to skip during analysis; e.g., 'tar', 'gzip' to avoid noise from archives/compression headers
